name: fm
runtime_note: Requires macOS 27 or later on Apple Silicon with Apple Intelligence enabled. The adapter uses the system /usr/bin/fm; Nix does not install macOS or its model. Run `fm available` to check model readiness. Select it with `ask -p fm`, or set `provider.default=fm` in Ask settings. Model and light mode both use `system`. Schemas are sent as prompt instructions and Ask validates the result. Apple native schemas require extensions that arbitrary Ask schemas do not provide.
